ratings.comment:
This teacher is terrible:
Always late (15 minutes late to the final)
Never prepared (late to the final because she forgot to print it out)
Terrible speaker
Lectures do not make sense
White board drawing are very unclear and borderline impossible to read
Changes her mind about assignments on the due date and then claims it was always this way

She's good in office hours and responds promptly to emails. Generly very helpful. I would give her a good rating if she graded anything during the semester. Inexcusable imo. The class itself was not very interesting or challenging outside of the last project, which was assigned during the last week of class (horrible idea).

Totally nice to have a female professor as a female student in CS. The best CS professor I have ever had. She explains every assignment to you, and really cares that you know the material. You will actually learn if you take her class and won't have to look everything up. If you put in effort you will get an A , and understand Unix.

One of the best teachers, I learned the material because she would do the assignments with us and explain why she was doing what she was doing. I would 100% recommend this class to her. I would also retake it if I had it too.

She seems to be better as a 215 professor, but for 460 she was a nightmare. She uses scripts to automatically grade everything, and often these scripts have bugs in them. Takes forever to grade anything, I didn't know my grade for half the coursework until weeks after the class ended. I will be avoiding this professor at all cost.
ratings.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

ratings.comment: Dr. Watts is a very nice professor and many students love her. Her lectures are solid at helping students learn the C++ programming language. We do a wide variety of projects. However, the difficulty of the class comes where students are presumed to already have an understanding of C++, but that is not her choice.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

ratings.comment: Very project and lab heavy, that is about 89% of the work in the class. Test's are tough but fair, study and utilize S.I's and you should be able to get by with a passing grade.

Knows a lot and answers questions well. Lectures dont help much with HW/projects. Lots of HW (6)/projects (3) so very busy class. Projects are group and she assigns grades based off how much work each person in the group does. This method of grading is unfair and will screw you over. 2 take home tests. Slow to grade and little feedback if any.

Dr. Watts knows her stuff. All these bitter students giving awful ratings were probably the ones who sit in lab on their phone, don't read a book on C++,  or take advantage of the notes you can bring to tests. Show up to class, read, don't fall behind, go to office hours, start projects early, and you'll get your A.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

ratings.comment: Great Teacher, sure she was late for class sometimes but I feel it is greatly exaggerated in comments below. Basically if you dont put in the time you wont pass. The material comes easy to some, hard to others. Do your labs and understand them and you will pass. Simple. Easy class and I learned alot!
She's a good teacher and definitely knows her stuff. You get what you put into the class. She can be very unorganized but if you go to her to her office hours, she will be more than willing to help.
ratings.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

ratings.comment: Sadly the worst CS class I've taken this far. She definitely knows her stuff but considering both the code in the lecture and the labs have typos and small errors within in them it is impossible to do anything but learn everything by yourself. As long as you do the labs and know what goes on in code for tests you'll pass but with no help from her.

She is not a good instructor and she is not very good in explaining how to properly code, she expects you to know the language that you are learning already, she shows up late to every class, her labs are awful she is the worst professor I have ever had. Her projects are incredibly confusing and half the class dosent even turn them in.

Almost always late with no apology. Does not care to help during labs and on top of that the labs are poorly written and filled with typos creating an atmosphere of frustration. The projects and poorly explained and rely on the notes in class which are usually rushed and hard to follow. Unfair grader; doesn't care about students; yikes; too old?;
ratings.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

ratings.comment: Prof. Watts is very kind, helpful, & knows her stuff. Frequently late to class...  Format is frustrating - you're thrust into labs FIRST, knowing nothing about what you're doing, w/a lecture about it AFTER. Best advice: don't slack on labs. You have a week to finish them, so don't fall behind. Ask questions. Use her guides to study for the test.

Yeah, you can ask for help, and she'll help. If she's available. She'll also make you feel incredibly bad for not knowing it. Literally throws you into the course with the expectation that you know C++ pretty much. Lectures are all over the place, in general not an easy class

Worst teacher I've ever had. She is completely disorganized, incredibly condescending and does NOT explain things at all. Labs will start using new operator and languages (MFC) which she will NOT EXPLAIN AT ALL. She does NOT grade on time and is a VERY HARSH GRADER. Tests are very hard, riddled with ambiguous answers. Gave a quiz 5 min before class

She is a great professor, but sometimes her lectures are a little all over the place. If you need help, she will be happy to help. Her class is tough, but if you work hard you can pass. She also gives extra credit in projects to help your grade if you are struggling. :)

Her class required me to teach myself a lot of the material, but I've been told thats how it is in most CS classes from Programming II on. She's very helpful when you ask questions in class or lab and really knows all the material. It's true though, she takes forever to hand things back, but it's easy to know around where your grade is.

She knows what she is talking about but has trouble communicating it. Never hands back any work, you will never have any idea what your grade is. You basically have to teach this class to yourself. Doesn't care if entire class is 3 labs behind, she will move on anyway. Very poor teacher.

Professor Watts is very nice and helpful and also reeaally smart! if you need help you can just ask her but don't expect to be emailed back. She has a really hard time getting organized- its the end of the semester and i still don't know what i got on the first test.. overall fun class if you're interested in CS

Horrible semester. Never got anything back since beginning of the semester so hard to tell how you are doing. AMAZINGLY behind according to the syllabus. If you can't understand how to think outside the box do not take this class. Is helpful IF you can get to her. Exams are intense and hard, need to study A LOT outside of class.

She is always late, doesn't post assignments and you never get work back or know your grade. However she is very helpful and very knowledgable. You will learn alot. Study for her test or you will fail.

I had her as my lab teacher for Computer Science and she is really nice. The class is pretty easy and straight-forward because all you have to do is follow the instructions they give you. Seriously though, READ THE DIRECTIONS and follow them to get a really easy A

I had Carter or lecture and Watts for lab, she was very helpful when it came to answering questions. Lab is mandatory for passing CS 101, but the activities are pretty easy. Take this class if you get the chance.

She started the first class with, "I don't want this class to kill you guys." Several students muttered about how different that was from usual. Game Programming, as an elective, is taught at a very laid back level, and Tia is making it nice and easy for us.

Her exam was definately not an easy . You have to think alot before you put down your answer. I agree that she makes some mistakes during the class but it is  understandible ones... She is really smart and exactly knows what to teach and has great passion in teaching.

She teaches off the top of her head and makes SOOO many mistakes on the board that when you look at your notes, half of it is WRONG! It's good if there's a student that can constantly correct her. Her grading takes FOREVER and she's late all the time. She leaves during lab and that's just a crime. Thanks to tenure, she'll never have to worry tho.

She knows her stuff buts sometimes goes a little fast. If you are in class she will help you but good luck getting her answer your email. Never updates the web site and does not return work as fast as she could. Overall she is good. I would suggest taking her.

It's hard to take notes, because she constantly changes what she writes on the board.  Her labs and projects are very time demanding and she has a tendency of showing up late every day to 8 am classes.  She does do a good job helping out and explains things clearly.
I think Tia is great!!!  If you are a student that is dumb and lazy she is not the teacher for you.  However if you are smart and motivated she will rock you!!

Not well organized.  It really made me mad that she would lecture for half the lab period, because she couldn't pack enough into the class lecture.  Then she leaves the lab to go grade papers in her office.  She totally ditches students in lab time!

Compared to some of the other CS teachers, she's great...easy to follow, will use every second of the time she has with you (and some).  When your in her classes it sucks, but if you do the work you'll have learned a lot when your done.

the only positive thing that i can say about her is that its pretty easy to follow along in class with the work. her labs are way too hard for a 3 hour lab period. the tests are way too hard for and hour and she grades completely unfairly. Bad eacher
she is a good teacher, but wow she can be overly strict and sometimes even , dare i say it, a ****.
great
helpful in person, but not on e-mails, awful course web-site
Tia is one of the best..her tests are tooooo longgggg though
A  Little Dynamo ! :-)
Helpful, Dedicated.
High expectations, covers material well
